مَا نَبْغِى , in the Kur [xii. 65], is said to mean We do not lie: and we do not act wrongfully: or it may mean what do we seek, or desire? (TA.) ―
-b2- Also, (K,) inf. n. بَغْىٌ, (TA,) He looked at a thing [to see] how it was; (K;) and so بَغَا, inf. n. بَغْوٌ: mentioned by Kr. (TA.) ―
-b3- And, (K,) with the same inf. n., (TA,) He looked, watched, or waited, for a person or thing. (Kr, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
